# Paxio

> Paxio is a parental control app for Android that helps a parent set daily screen time limits, block distracting apps, filter content by category, enforce bedtime schedules, and pause internet access remotely — from one dashboard. It syncs across devices via the parent's account and does not read a child's texts, calls, or private messages.

Paxio is installed on a child's Android device and managed from a parent's own device or the same device in a separate profile. Free and Pro plans are available; Pro adds more child profiles, unlimited app blocking, bedtime locks, remote internet pause, and longer report history. Paxio also runs a free standalone tool, App Checker, for looking up any Google Play app's permissions, ads, and age rating before a parent lets their kid install it.
